items.title: the BASE-CACHE KEY carries no std ROOT: two byte-identical std roots (the tree's `std_root()` and the materialized `~/.vilan/std-cache` std) file under ONE key, so M19's hard assertion (the `references::` fingerprint collision — two fingerprints equal exactly `sources[1..]` of `import std::io::print` under the two roots) can fire in ONE LSP session with documents inside and outside a checkout — a product bug, seen in-suite as the five `references::` panics under plain `cargo test` (N131); the cache pins also read other tests' worlds because `BASE_CACHE_LOCK` serializes only the ~33 pins that take it
items.discussion: std-42 (2026-09-25); documented at `BASE_CACHE_LOCK` in vilan-lsp/src/document.rs; the analyzer's cache key (solver's file)
items.body: Fix: `BaseCacheKey` includes the std root's identity (path or digest); a two-root LSP pin (a document under the checkout + one outside) red-first. Sizing S–M; solver lane, Order 43.
